kept_items.author: thsottiaux
kept_items.text: Morning. The last 48 hours of Codex and ChatGPT Work have been intense! Three important updates: temporarily removing the 5 hour usage limit restriction for all Plus, Business and Pro plans; rolling out changes to make GPT-5.6 Sol more efficient.
kept_items.selection_reason: OpenAI product/infra update from a named OpenAI leader; concrete change to usage limits, high engagement.

kept_items.author: claudeai
kept_items.text: We're extending Claude Fable 5 access on all paid plans, as well as keeping Claude Code's weekly rate limits 50% higher, through July 19.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official Anthropic announcement extending Fable 5 access and higher Claude Code limits through July 19; concrete, very high engagement.

kept_items.author: DataChaz
kept_items.text: COLIBRI runs GLM-5.2, a 744B model, on a 25GB machine with no GPU, holding the core in RAM and streaming the rest from disk.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete open-source inference milestone: running a 744B MoE model on 25GB RAM with no GPU.

kept_items.author: _avichawla
kept_items.text: NVIDIA researchers built a new transformer variant; a single change to the layers made decoding 1.7x faster and lifted long-reasoning accuracy by 6.5 points by adding a fourth projection.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete technical research: NVIDIA transformer architecture tweak with measured speed and accuracy gains.

kept_items.author: RoundtableSpace
kept_items.text: A Gemini 3.5 Pro benchmark leak reportedly shows it outperforming Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 in internal evals, with zero-shot gains over 3.1 Pro, currently in private validation.
kept_items.selection_reason: Model-competition signal: leaked Gemini 3.5 Pro benchmark claims against current frontier models.

kept_items.author: VaibhavSisinty
kept_items.text: Satya Nadella published an article introducing the Reverse Information Paradox, arguing companies using AI pay twice: once with money and again with something more valuable.
kept_items.selection_reason: Named executive (Nadella) publishing a framing on AI's hidden cost; strong reach.

kept_items.author: IntCyberDigest
kept_items.text: Samsung is forcing users to hand over data for AI training by breaking core Health app functionality; a new consent notice covers activity, health records, medication and menstrual cycle data, and opting out disables syncing.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete AI-data-consent policy move affecting consumer health data.

kept_items.author: sama
kept_items.text: Sam Altman asked to see interesting things people have built with 5.6 Sol, offering the maker of the coolest one a special gift from the OpenAI archives.
kept_items.selection_reason: Direct from Altman; signals OpenAI push around 5.6 Sol adoption, very high reach.

kept_items.author: Kalshi
kept_items.text: Elon Musk says OpenAI stole all of Apple's phone technology, escalating after Apple filed its lawsuit.
kept_items.selection_reason: Fresh escalation angle on the Apple/OpenAI lawsuit; distinct from prior day's Altman-response framing.

kept_items.author: karlmehta
kept_items.text: Demis Hassabis explains why static AI regulation is obsolete before it is written, describing a prisoner's dilemma where taking more time to make something safer is harder than shipping it.
kept_items.selection_reason: Substantive Hassabis observation on AI regulation dynamics; distinct from prior Hassabis science-progress framing.

kept_items.author: cgtwts
kept_items.text: A widely shared post notes Notion engineers watching their note-taking app expand into a CRM, Jira, GitHub, docs, and now an AI software company.
kept_items.selection_reason: Practitioner-community read on Notion's expansion into AI software; strong engagement.
